notes.title: Revenant Patch Notes 1.09c
notes.content:
1. Trash Bin Location Adjusted
- The trash bin, an object linked to anomalies, was relocated to a more accessible position for player convenience.

2. Removal of Unnecessary Objects
- Removed several complex objects that could be mistaken for anomalies.

3. Hand Mirror Interaction Sound Fix
- Resolved an issue where sound effects played repeatedly when interacting multiple times with the hand mirror.

notes.title: Revenant 1.08n Patch Notes
notes.content:
1. Removal of Random Ambient Noises
- Random ambient sounds causing excessive stress to players have been removed.

2. Adjustment to Wrong Answer Penalty
- The penalty for selecting a wrong answer has been adjusted. Players will no longer return directly to Floor 0 but instead move down one floor at a time to balance difficulty.

3. Removal of Excessive Jump Scare Event
- A jump scare event triggered by specific objects, deemed overly stressful for players, has been removed.

4. Player Camera Sensitivity Calculation Updated
- Due to mouse stuttering issues found on certain systems, the sensitivity calculation formula has been updated. New players can ignore this change.
(Existing players are advised to adjust their sensitivity multiplier by approximately 0.01 for optimal experience.)

5. Storage Room Password Hint Revised
The original password hint, considered overly complicated, has been revised for easier deciphering.

6. Reduced Interaction Fatigue
Most interactive objects have been made non-interactive to reduce player fatigue caused by excessive interactions.

7. Removal of Mandatory Story Object Interactions
Mandatory interactions with story objects have been removed to enhance replayability and accommodate players less focused on the narrative.

8. New Anomalies Added
Several new anomalies fitting the game’s storyline have been introduced.

9. Safe Handle Collection Hint Added
A hint regarding the location for collecting the safe handle has been added.

10. Changed Conditions for Safe Handle Collection
- Before: Obtainable only with 0 wrong answers.  
- After: Obtainable with 1 or fewer wrong answers.

11. Relaxed Conditions for Unlocking Anomaly Viewer Bonus
- Before: Unlock at 50% story completion.  
- After: Unlock at 25% story completion.

12. UI Improvements
- Fixed visual glitches occurring when rapidly clicking buttons in certain UI elements.

notes.title: Announcement About the Game Patch
notes.content:
Hello, this is ShinYerak Studio.

We have identified several issues related to gameplay and have begun working on fixes.

The key improvements include:

1. Revising unintuitive systems for better clarity
2. Simplifying interactive elements
3. Removing stress-inducing sound effects

We aim to make the systems more user-friendly and will do our best to complete these updates by the end of March.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your patience.
Thank you for your continued support.

- ShinYerak Studio
